name: Observation AP: laser normal points to an AP $OCM
description: A host flow (flow.mjs observationAp; no WebAssembly artifact of its own) that routes typed records between shipped modules: flows/observation-od step with propagator/ffm invoke and analysis/estimation fit_batch to the laser estimate ($OCM), propagator/ffm propagate_oem carrying it 24 h back at 60 s under the same dynamics and fitted parameters ($OEM), and propagator/sdn-ap fit with the estimate's PVN on provenance (the AP $OCM). A module's refusal returns by name, unchanged.

methods.displayName: Laser normal points to an AP $OCM

inputPorts.description: The normal points: one $TDM per pass from data-source/ilrs-crd-source read_crd.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The station coordinates: one $GST per pad from data-source/ilrs-station-coordinates read_sinex.
